CMP.wp.products[2].why|/0: A bitumen-free thick coating tested to the German regulation for bitumen thick coatings (PG MDS/FPD) — the category that replaces bitumen on the outside of basements under DIN 18533; Mapelastic 2KR Plus is the only comparison product in the same category and publishes no figures on its page.
CMP.wp.products[2].why|/1: Crack bridging to 2 mm and 5 bar at 3 mm dry film, rainproof after approx. 3 hours on slopes, pressing water after approx. 16 hours — the excavation can be closed the next day.
CMP.wp.products[2].why|/2: Light: approx. 1.1 kg/m² per mm (density approx. 1.1 kg/dm³) — fewer kilograms carried for the same thickness than the 1.2–2.0 kg/m² per mm of the cementitious membranes.
CMP.wp.products[2].why|/3: Negative pressure value published (0.75 bar, WTA 4-6) for the inside of the pit as well.
CMP.wp.products[3].type|: crack-bridging cementitious surface protection system, OS 5b / EN 1504-2
CMP.wp.products[3].charts[0].title|: CO₂ diffusion equivalent air layer Sd
CMP.wp.products[3].why|/0: Classified as an OS 5b surface protection system (Rili-SIB / DIN V 18026) — the German class for crack-bridging protection of concrete; none of the comparison sheets claims the class.
CMP.wp.products[3].why|/1: Dynamic crack bridging class B2 at −20 °C after 2,000 hours of UV weathering is published — the behaviour in winter and after ageing, not only the static value at +20 °C.
CMP.wp.products[3].why|/2: CO₂ diffusion Sd > 200 m against 104 m (Sikalastic-6100 FX) and > 50 m (SikaTop-550 Seal): a carbonation brake of twice the thickness-equivalent.
CMP.wp.products[3].why|/3: Consumption for the OS 5b build-up is published as a system value (approx. 5.5 kg/m²).
CMP.rc.subtitle|: AQUAFIN-IC, ASOCRET-IM and FIX-20-T against Penetron, Kryton, Master Builders Solutions (SikaTop / SikaSet) and Mapei
CMP.rc.note|: Xypex products are not included in this comparison.
CMP.rc.products[0].type|: crystalline waterproofing slurry, brush, broom or spray, two coats
CMP.rc.products[0].why|/0: The negative pressure resistance is a published figure (1.5 bar) and the impermeability a test value (14 bar, CRD-C 48-92); the comparable sheets describe "either side" application without a negative value, and only Krystol T1 publishes a CRD-C 48 result.
CMP.rc.products[0].why|/1: EN 1504-2 values measured, not declared as classes: capillary absorption w < 0.1 kg/m²·h⁰·⁵ and Sd < 5 m.
CMP.rc.products[0].why|/2: Working time approx. 60 minutes — twice to three times the 20–30 minutes of the crystalline slurries compared.
CMP.rc.products[0].why|/3: Consumption by water load from 0.75 kg/m² (one coat) to 1.5 kg/m² (two coats), with drinking-water testing to DVGW W 270 / W 347.
CMP.rc.products[1].type|: crystalline repair mortar for chased cracks and coves
CMP.rc.products[1].charts[1].title|: Consumption per metre of 20–25 mm chase
CMP.rc.products[1].why|/0: Published per metre: approx. 1.3 kg/m for the 20 × 25 mm chase and for the 38 mm cove — the drawing gives the quantity directly.
CMP.rc.products[1].why|/1: Working time approx. 30 minutes, 10 mm per step, and AQUAFIN-IC follows wet in wet after 1–3 hours: crack, cove and coating in one shift.
CMP.rc.products[1].why|/2: Compressive strength approx. 20 N/mm² by design — a mortar matched to the slurry on top, not a structural grout; the comparable grouts publish 48–49 N/mm².
CMP.rc.products[2].why|/0: Swellable: the plug expands as it sets and locks into the dovetailed chase against the running water.
CMP.rc.products[2].why|/1: Strength development published at 1 hour, 24 hours and 28 days (approx. 3 / 15 / 30 N/mm²) and consumption per litre of void (approx. 2 kg/l) — the comparable plugs publish strength at 7 days or in psi, and no yield per void.
CMP.rc.products[2].why|/2: Working time approx. 2 minutes: long enough to press the plug and hold it, short enough to stop the flow.
CMP.rc.products[2].why|/3: Part of the crystalline system: the plug is overcoated with ASOCRET-IM and AQUAFIN-IC, no separate waterstop product line.
CMP.ca.subtitle|: BETOCRETE crystalline admixtures against Penetron, Kryton, Sika, Master Builders Solutions and Mapei
CMP.ca.note|: Xypex products are not included in this comparison. No comparable product combining a crystalline admixture with a corrosion inhibitor (BETOCRETE-CP350-CI) was found at the manufacturers compared.
CMP.ca.products[0].type|: liquid crystalline waterproofing admixture with liquefying (plasticising) properties
CMP.ca.products[0].charts[0].title|: Dosage, % of cement weight (lower = less admixture per m³)
CMP.ca.products[0].charts[1].title|: Minimum cement content (lower = more mix designs qualify)
CMP.ca.products[0].why|/0: Two effects from one liquid: the crystalline waterproofing and a plasticising effect that reduces the water demand of the mix — the comparable liquids are pore blockers or crystalline admixtures without a stated plasticising action.
CMP.ca.products[0].why|/1: Minimum cement content 270 kg/m³ (CEM I), published; Sika WT-100 L requires 350 kg/m³ and a w/c ≤ 0.45.
CMP.ca.products[0].why|/2: Dosed with the mixing water at the plant or into the truck on site, with the mixing time per m³ stated — the procedure is written for the Taiwanese ready-mix practice (truck dosing).
CMP.ca.products[0].why|/3: Minimum binder contents are published per cement type (CEM I / II / III), so the recipe check is part of the data sheet.
CMP.ca.products[1].type|: powder crystalline waterproofing admixture with hydrophobic properties, in water-soluble bags
CMP.ca.products[1].why|/0: Crystalline and hydrophobic in one powder: the pores are blocked by crystal growth and made water-repellent, two mechanisms against capillary water.
CMP.ca.products[1].why|/1: Dosage approx. 0.75–1.25 % of the cement — in water-soluble bags for the mixer truck, with the mixing time per m³ stated.
CMP.ca.products[1].why|/2: Minimum cement content from 270 kg/m³ (CEM I) is published; Sika WT-200 P and Idrocrete KR 1000 require 350 kg/m³.
CMP.ca.products[1].why|/3: The data sheet names the CEM types and blends for which the dosage applies; the comparable sheets give a general dosage per m³ or per 100 kg of cementitious material.
